correctness.rationale: Structural induction handles all formula tests by splitting over globally constant test truth-values. Parikh semilinearity and the finite cyclic subsemigroup = subgroup identity give the gcd restriction, including negative/zero/empty generators. Explicit loop programs define all singleton and prime-power divisibility predicates; CRT and finite gcd residue counting yield nondefinability and density. The finite verification reproduces key identities without being treated as an infinite proof.
